selection: source calibration attack recall under source empirical FPR constraint; then lower FPR; then simpler cost; target labels rejected
capture_split: deterministic global capture assignment before performance inspection; final capture pool never used for fitting or selection
comparison_requirement: A/B feature effect is causal only if captures, label provenance and comparable sampling can be matched; otherwise separate descriptive tracks

study.estimand: Conditional performance among sampled flows with traceable binary label support; not full-traffic performance.
study.original_full_traffic_gate: Preserved separately, never overridden by this study.
study.selection: Source train/calibration only; source recall under empirical FPR<=0.01 or 0.05; source tie-breaks fixed.
study.preprocessing: Source-training median imputation, signed log1p, source-training standardization.
study.student: 12-64-32-2 MLP, dropout 0.1; matched supervised/KD capacity; weighted CE/KL, T=3, hard fraction=0.25.
study.teacher: XGBoost 300 trees, depth6, lr0.05, subsample/colsample0.9; 4 training threads.
study.controls: LR C1 max_iter2000; RF200 trees; identical source cohorts and transform; all declared class costs.
study.quantization: Dynamic INT8; row-wise TorchScript scoring; source-only operating-point calibration.
study.ablation: At source FPR0.05, all four components share cost1 or the KD source-selected cost; each has its own original source threshold.
study.missingness: Unknown labels are never imputed. Sharp bounds permit every unknown class assignment, including nonrandom missingness.
study.uncertainty: Five seeds condition on fixed capture pools; not independent deployment-site confidence intervals.
study.chronology: Capture-disjoint roles are retained; capture files need not be independent acquisition sessions.
study.compression_scope: Desktop completed-flow inference only; not Raspberry Pi/Jetson evidence.
